title: Capacity Concierge: Scaling knobs, throughput explorer, and event ledger
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Build a unified Fleet Controls panel called 'Capacity Concierge' in the Redwood Console that lets cluster operators (platform admins and tenant operators) configure scaling controls, explore fleet throughput and latency, and inspect an immutable change ledger. The goal is to reduce operator guesswork when tuning Dedicated capacity, surface cost/latency trade-offs, and provide an auditable history with easy rollback paths.
acceptance_criteria: Console surface exposes three primary tabs: Scaling Controls, Throughput Explorer, Event Ledger
Scaling Controls supports: manual instance slider, scheduled policies, and autoscale policy editor with min/max and cooldown settings
Throughput Explorer displays tenant-level and cluster-level QPS, tokens/sec, p50/p95/p99 latency, and reserved vs consumed capacity with percentile breakdowns
Event Ledger records user+API changes with diffs, timestamp, actor, reason, and a one-click 'open rollback' action that creates an operator task
Preview panel shows estimated monthly cost delta for scaling changes (based on pricing config) before apply
All features are behind a console feature flag and are gated for Dedicated clusters only
Telemetry emits: scaling_policy_change, manual_scale, throughput_query, ledger_entry_view, rollback_initiated
design_notes: Primary layout: left column for fleet selector and quick presets, middle for active controls and preview, right for realtime throughput tiles
Scaling Controls: use compact sliders for min/max, a timeline editor for scheduled policies, and preset chips (Burst, Economical, Balanced)
Throughput Explorer: heatmap of request rate by minute, histogram selector for percentiles, and per-tenant stack bars for consumption
Event Ledger: show compact list with expandable diffs. Each entry links to the operator who made the change and a related ticket or PR if provided
Accessibility: keyboard shortcuts to open preset menu and to focus the preview cost panel
engineering_notes: Backend API: extend /api/v1/fleets/{id}/scaling to accept new autoscale schema (target_metric, min_instances, max_instances, cooldown_s)
Throughput service: roll up tokens/sec and latencies into 1m and 5m aggregates; provide tenant-scoped endpoints
Event Ledger: append-only table with change blobs and metadata; surface diffs on read using stored prev_state hashes
Estimate: frontend 3 sprints, backend 4 sprints, e2e + load tests 2 sprints
rollout_plan: Alpha: internal-only rollout to SRE and Customer Success (2 clusters) for 2 weeks
Beta: opt-in for 5 customers on Dedicated with engineer support; collect feedback and usage metrics
GA: enable for all Dedicated clusters behind RBAC (platform-admins can enable per-tenant)
Post-GA: iterate on cost preview accuracy and add Terraform provider support
telemetry: scaling_policy_changed: includes fleet_id, policy_id, actor, old_spec, new_spec
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: incorrect cost preview could cause surprises for customers -> Mitigation: conservative safety margin and clearly labeled estimate (±20%)
Risk: autoscale oscillation with aggressive cooldowns -> Mitigation: implement dampening (exponential backoff) and soft thresholds for scale-down
Risk: ledger grows fast for noisy changes -> Mitigation: compact older entries into summary rows and keep full blobs in cold storage
Risk: exposing tenant data in throughput explorer -> Mitigation: RBAC checks and tenant-scoped visibility; anonymize when required
